visual_description: A contemporary open‑plan office bathed in soft natural light from a large window. In the foreground, a mid‑30s professional in business‑casual attire sits at a tidy desk. Their right hand hovers over a blank‑looking contract‑style sheet, a black ball‑point pen poised to sign. The document rests on a wooden desk alongside a coffee mug, a stack of generic paperwork, and a sleek laptop whose screen shows an abstract workflow diagram in muted blues and greens (no readable text). Just behind the seated figure, a colleague in a similar outfit stands slightly turned, holding an open folder with several pages fanned out. The colleague’s left hand points toward the document on the desk, while the right hand rests on the folder’s edge, suggesting they are delivering instructions or an order for the signed procedure. The background shows a few other workstations with monitors and office chairs, but the focus remains on the interaction between the two employees and the act of signing. The camera is positioned at eye level, angled slightly to capture both the signing hand and the gesturing colleague, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the desk surface and documents crisp while softly blurring the distant office space. The lighting is even, with gentle shadows under the desk and on the participants’ faces, emphasizing the seriousness of the moment without any overt legal symbols. MANDATORY VISUAL REGENERATION NOTES: A professional, high-quality, 4:5 portrait photograph of a contemporary open-plan office. A mid-30s professional is sitting at a clean desk, about to sign a contract document. A colleague stands next to them, pointing at the document with a folder in hand, explaining the procedure. The atmosphere is serious and professional. Natural lighting, shallow depth of field, focused on the interaction and the document. No text on papers or screens. Avoid people and hands when possible. Prefer a clean, realistic scene with objects/documents only.
